declarations.name: QuarticQuery.Amplification.bounded_amplification
declarations.source_statement:
theorem bounded_amplification {γ η : ℝ} (hγ : 0 < γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ 1 / 2) (hη : 0 < η)
    (hη1 : η < 1 / 2) :
    (amplify γ η).callCap ≤ trialCount η * (2 * iterationBound γ + 1) ∧
    ((amplify γ η).callCap : ℝ) ≤ 138 * (Real.sqrt γ)⁻¹ * Real.log (1 / η) ∧
    ∀ {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] (A : Preparation H),
      (amplify γ η).successProb A + (amplify γ η).failProb A = 1 ∧
      (∀ h : Option H → ℝ, PhaseInvariant h →
        (amplify γ η).expect A h A.zero =
          (amplify γ η).successProb A * h (some A.goodState) +
          (amplify γ η).failProb A * h none) ∧
      (∀ k : H → ℝ, (∀ c : ℂ, ‖c‖ = 1 → ∀ v, k (c • v) = k v) →
        (amplify γ η).successProb A ≠ 0 →
        (amplify γ η).conditional A k = k A.goodState) ∧
      (amplify γ η).wrongStateMass A = 0 ∧
      (γ ≤ A.prob → (amplify γ η).failProb A ≤ η) ∧
      (A.prob = 0 → (amplify γ η).failProb A = 1)

    (((Real.sqrt (Fintype.card ι))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) • ∑ i, branch i
  read_branch : ∀ i j, read i (branch j) = if i = j then branch j else 0

def Proc.callCap : Proc → ℕ
  | .fail => 0
  | .success => 0
  | .restart next => next.callCap
  | .run c next => c.calls + next.callCap
  | .measure yes no => max yes.callCap no.callCap
  | .mix _ _ branch => Finset.univ.sup fun j => (branch j).callCap

noncomputable def Proc.expect (A : Preparation H) (h : Option H → ℝ) : Proc → H → ℝ
  | .fail, φ => ‖φ‖ ^ 2 * h none
  | .success, φ => ‖φ‖ ^ 2 * h (some (normalised φ))
  | .restart next, φ => next.expect A h (((‖φ‖ : ℝ) : ℂ) • A.zero)
  | .run c next, φ => next.expect A h (Circuit.run A c φ)
  | .measure yes no, φ =>
      yes.expect A h (A.good φ) + no.expect A h (φ - A.good φ)
  | .mix _ weight branch, φ => ∑ j, weight j * (branch j).expect A h φ

    intro ψ
    ext z

    rw [← mul_assoc, hcc, one_mul])
  norm_map' ψ := by
    have hn : ∀ z, ‖c z‖ = 1 := fun z => by
      have h := congrArg norm (hcc z)

    rw [reg_norm_sq, reg_norm_sq]

declarations.name: QuarticQuery.Upper.embOrth
declarations.source_statement:
noncomputable def embOrth {Y : Type} [Fintype Y] (v : Y → E) (hv : Orthonormal ℂ v) :
    Reg Y →ₗᵢ[ℂ] E where
  toFun ψ := ∑ y, ψ.ofLp y • v y
  map_add' ψ φ := by
    simp only [PiLp.add_apply, add_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  map_smul' a ψ := by
    simp only [PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_smul, RingHom.id_apply, Finset.smul_sum]
  norm_map' ψ := by
    refine (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp ?_
    have h := hv.inner_sum (fun y => ψ.ofLp y) (fun y => ψ.ofLp y) Finset.univ
    have hc : ∀ y, (starRingEnd ℂ) (ψ.ofLp y) * ψ.ofLp y = ((‖ψ.ofLp y‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := fun y => by
      rw [Complex.conj_mul']
      push_cast
      rfl
    change ‖∑ y, ψ.ofLp y • v y‖ ^ 2 = ‖ψ‖ ^ 2
    rw [norm_sq_eq_re_inner (𝕜 := ℂ), h, reg_norm_sq]
    simp only [hc]
    rw [← Complex.ofReal_sum]
    exact Complex.ofReal_re _

theorem tournament_runs {cc cV : ℕ} {a : BitInput ι → Col → Col → ℝ} {v : BitInput ι → Col → ℝ}
    (hm : 2 ≤ Fintype.card Col) (hc : ∀ x, IsComparison (a x)) (hu : ∀ x, UnitValued (a x))
    (hcmp : ∀ i p, Samples cc fun x b => bern (a x i p) b)
    (hv : ∀ c, Runs cV fun x b => bern (v x c) b) (hv01 : ∀ x c, 0 ≤ v x c ∧ v x c ≤ 1) :
    let m := Fintype.card Col
    let T := Tval m
    let ε := epsval m
    ∃ val : BitInput ι → ℝ,
      Runs (T * stageCost m T cc ε + T * cV) (fun x b => bern (val x) b) ∧
      (∀ x, (∀ c, v x c ≤ ε) → val x ≤ T * ε) ∧
      (∀ x s, Dominant (a x) ε s → 1 - ε ≤ v x s →
        1 - 2 * (m : ℝ) / 2 ^ T - T * ε - ε ≤ val x)

declarations.name: QuarticQuery.Paper.quantum_grover_state
declarations.source_statement:
theorem quantum_grover_state (A : Preparation H) (h0 : 0 < A.prob) (h1 : A.prob < 1) :
    (0 < A.angle ∧ A.angle < Real.pi / 2) ∧
    ‖A.goodState‖ = 1 ∧ ‖A.badState‖ = 1 ∧
    A.good A.goodState = A.goodState ∧ A.good A.badState = 0 ∧
    inner ℂ A.goodState A.badState = 0 ∧
    A.state = ((Real.sin A.angle : ℝ) : ℂ) • A.goodState +
      ((Real.cos A.angle : ℝ) : ℂ) • A.badState ∧
    ∀ ℓ : ℕ,
      A.iterate ℓ =
        ((Real.sin ((2 * ℓ + 1) * A.angle) : ℝ) : ℂ) • A.goodState +
        ((Real.cos ((2 * ℓ + 1) * A.angle) : ℝ) : ℂ) • A.badState ∧
      (A.good (A.iterate ℓ) ≠ 0 →
        PhaseEq (normalised (A.good (A.iterate ℓ))) A.goodState)
declarations.printed_full_type:
QuarticQuery.Paper.quantum_grover_state.{u_1} {H : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace Complex H]
  (A : QuarticQuery.Amplification.Preparation H) (h0 : LT.lt 0 A.prob) (h1 : LT.lt A.prob 1) :
  And (And (LT.lt 0 A.angle) (LT.lt A.angle (HDiv.hDiv Real.pi 2)))
    (And (Eq (norm A.goodState) 1)
      (And (Eq (norm A.badState) 1)
        (And (Eq (A.good A.goodState) A.goodState)
          (And (Eq (A.good A.badState) 0)
            (And (Eq (inner Complex A.goodState A.badState) 0)
              (And
                (Eq A.state
                  (HAdd.hAdd (HSMul.hSMul (↑(Real.sin A.angle)) A.goodState)
                    (HSMul.hSMul (↑(Real.cos A.angle)) A.badState)))
                (∀ (ℓ : Nat),
                  And
                    (Eq (A.iterate ℓ)
                      (HAdd.hAdd
                        (HSMul.hSMul (↑(Real.sin (HMul.hMul (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul 2 ↑ℓ) 1) A.angle))) A.goodState)
                        (HSMul.hSMul (↑(Real.cos (HMul.hMul (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul 2 ↑ℓ) 1) A.angle))) A.badState)))
                    (Ne (A.good (A.iterate ℓ)) 0 →
                      QuarticQuery.Amplification.PhaseEq (QuarticQuery.Amplification.normalised (A.good (A.iterate ℓ)))
                        A.goodState))))))))

    (hp : γ ≤ A.prob) (hhalf : A.prob ≤ 1 / 2) :
    let M := iterationBound γ
    (1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * (M : ℝ) * |Real.sin (2 * A.angle)|) ≤
      (1 / (M : ℝ)) * ∑ ℓ ∈ Finset.range M,
        Real.sin ((2 * ℓ + 1) * A.angle) ^ 2) ∧
    (9 / 20 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * (M : ℝ) * |Real.sin (2 * A.angle)|)

QuarticQuery.Paper.quantum_eq_9.{u_1} {H : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace Complex H]
  (A : QuarticQuery.Amplification.Preparation H) {γ : Real} (hγ : LT.lt 0 γ) (hp : LE.le γ A.prob)
  (hhalf : LE.le A.prob (1 / 2)) :
  have M := QuarticQuery.Amplification.iterationBound γ;
  And
    (LE.le (HSub.hSub (1 / 2) (HDiv.hDiv 1 (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul 2 ↑M) (abs (Real.sin (HMul.hMul 2 A.angle))))))
      (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv 1 ↑M)
        ((Finset.range M).sum fun ℓ => HPow.hPow (Real.sin (HMul.hMul (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul 2 ↑ℓ) 1) A.angle)) 2)))
    (LE.le (9 / 20)
      (HSub.hSub (1 / 2) (HDiv.hDiv 1 (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul 2 ↑M) (abs (Real.sin (HMul.hMul 2 A.angle)))))))

theorem quantum_controlled_bit_query {ι Z : Type} [Fintype ι] [Inhabited ι]
    [Fintype Z] {w : ℕ} (e : Z ↪ Fin (w + 1)) (R : ReadSpec ι Z) :
    ∃ P : AdaptiveProgram ι w → AdaptiveProgram ι w, ∀ next,
      (P next).queryCap = 2 + next.queryCap ∧
      ∀ x ψ b, (P next).outputMass x (clEmb e ψ) b =
        next.outputMass x (clEmb e (R.op x ψ)) b

        (∀ (x : QuarticQuery.BitInput ι) (ψ : QuarticQuery.Upper.Reg Z) (b : Bool),
          Eq ((P next).outputMass x ((QuarticQuery.Upper.clEmb e) ψ) b)

declarations.source_statement:
theorem quantumComparison_state (hk : 1 ≤ k) (n : ℕ) (i j : Col t) :
    ∃ (Z : Type) (_ : Fintype Z) (o : Z) (out : Z → Bool)
      (F : BitInput (Loc k t C) → Reg Z ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] Reg Z),
      IsCirc (cmpCost k t n) F ∧
      IsCirc (cmpCost k t n) (fun x => (F x).symm) ∧
      ∀ x b, lawOf (F x (rket o)) out b = bern (cmpProb n x i j) b

  Exists fun Z =>
    Exists fun x =>
      Exists fun o =>
        Exists fun out =>
          Exists fun F =>
            And (QuarticQuery.Upper.IsCirc (QuarticQuery.Upper.cmpCost k t n) F)
              (And (QuarticQuery.Upper.IsCirc (QuarticQuery.Upper.cmpCost k t n) fun x_1 => (F x_1).symm)
                (∀ (x_1 : QuarticQuery.BitInput (QuarticQuery.Upper.Loc k t C)) (b : Bool),
                  Eq (QuarticQuery.Upper.lawOf ((F x_1) (QuarticQuery.Upper.rket o)) out b)
                    (QuarticQuery.Upper.bern (QuarticQuery.Upper.cmpProb n x_1 i j) b)))

      ∀ x b,

        lawOf (F x (rket o)) (fun z => !(out z)) b = bern (cmpProb n x j i) b

    ∃ f : BitInput (Loc k t C) → ℝ,
      (∀ x, 0 ≤ f x ∧ f x ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ x e, localTest C (2 * t) (40 * t) x i s e = false → f x ≤ ε) ∧
      (∀ x, (∀ e, localTest C (2 * t) (40 * t) x i s e = true) → f x = 1) ∧

  Exists fun f =>
    And (∀ (x : QuarticQuery.BitInput (QuarticQuery.Upper.Loc k t C)), And (LE.le 0 (f x)) (LE.le (f x) 1))
      (And
        (∀

        (And

          (QuarticQuery.Upper.Runs (QuarticQuery.Upper.searchCost t (Fintype.card (QuarticQuery.Upper.Tests t C)) ε)

declarations.source_statement:
theorem quantumVerify (hk : 1 ≤ k) (ht : 1 ≤ t)
    (hC : CircuitRealises C (P k t)) {n : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    (hn : repetitions k (ε / (40 * t : ℕ)) ≤ n) :
    ∃ v : BitInput (Loc k t C) → Col t → ℝ,
      (∀ c, Runs (2 * addrCost k t n + searchCost t (Fintype.card (Tests t C)) ε)
        fun x b => bern (v x c) b) ∧
      (∀ x c, 0 ≤ v x c ∧ v x c ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ x c, (¬ ∃ s, WinsAt (P k t) C (2 * t) (40 * t) x c s) → v x c ≤ ε) ∧
      (∀ x c s, WinsAt (P k t) C (2 * t) (40 * t) x c s → 1 - ε ≤ v x c)

declarations.printed_full_type:
QuarticQuery.Paper.quantumVerify {k t : Nat} {C : QuarticQuery.Circuit (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t)}
  (hk : LE.le 1 k) (ht : LE.le 1 t) (hC : QuarticQuery.CircuitRealises C (QuarticQuery.P k t)) {n : Nat} {ε : Real}
  (hε : LT.lt 0 ε) (hε1 : LE.le ε 1)
  (hn : LE.le (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.repetitions k (HDiv.hDiv ε ↑(HMul.hMul 40 t))) n) :
  Exists fun v =>
    And
      (∀ (c : QuarticQuery.Upper.Col t),
        QuarticQuery.Upper.Runs
          (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul 2 (QuarticQuery.Upper.addrCost k t n))
            (QuarticQuery.Upper.searchCost t (Fintype.card (QuarticQuery.Upper.Tests t C)) ε))
          fun x b => QuarticQuery.Upper.bern (v x c) b)
      (And
        (∀ (x : QuarticQuery.BitInput (QuarticQuery.Upper.Loc k t C)) (c : QuarticQuery.Upper.Col t),
          And (LE.le 0 (v x c)) (LE.le (v x c) 1))
        (And
          (∀
            (x :
              QuarticQuery.BitInput
                (QuarticQuery.BitLoc (HMul.hMul 2 t) (HMul.hMul 40 t) C.size (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t)))
            (c : QuarticQuery.Column (HMul.hMul 2 t)),
            Not (Exists fun s => QuarticQuery.WinsAt (QuarticQuery.P k t) C (HMul.hMul 2 t) (HMul.hMul 40 t) x c s) →
              LE.le (v x c) ε)
          (∀
            (x :
              QuarticQuery.BitInput
                (QuarticQuery.BitLoc (HMul.hMul 2 t) (HMul.hMul 40 t) C.size (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t)))
            (c : QuarticQuery.Column (HMul.hMul 2 t)) (s : QuarticQuery.Address (HMul.hMul 40 t)),
            QuarticQuery.WinsAt (QuarticQuery.P k t) C (HMul.hMul 2 t) (HMul.hMul 40 t) x c s →
              LE.le (HSub.hSub 1 ε) (v x c))))

declarations.name: QuarticQuery.Paper.quantumError_bound
declarations.source_statement:
theorem quantumError_bound (hk : 1 ≤ k) (ht : 1 ≤ t)
    (hC : CircuitRealises C (P k t)) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : repetitions k (epsval (mValue t) / (40 * t : ℕ)) ≤ n) :
    ∃ val : BitInput (Loc k t C) → ℝ,
      Runs (budget k t n (Fintype.card (Tests t C)))
        (fun x b => bern (val x) b) ∧
      (∀ x, Fkm k t C x = false →
        val x ≤ (Tval (mValue t) : ℝ) * epsval (mValue t)) ∧
      (∀ x, Fkm k t C x = true →
        1 - val x ≤ 2 * (mValue t : ℝ) / 2 ^ Tval (mValue t) +
          (Tval (mValue t) : ℝ) * epsval (mValue t) + epsval (mValue t))

declarations.printed_full_type:
QuarticQuery.Paper.quantumError_bound {k t : Nat} {C : QuarticQuery.Circuit (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t)}
  (hk : LE.le 1 k) (ht : LE.le 1 t) (hC : QuarticQuery.CircuitRealises C (QuarticQuery.P k t)) {n : Nat}
  (hn :
    LE.le
      (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.repetitions k
        (HDiv.hDiv (QuarticQuery.Tournament.epsval (QuarticQuery.mValue t)) ↑(HMul.hMul 40 t)))
      n) :
  Exists fun val =>
    And
      (QuarticQuery.Upper.Runs (QuarticQuery.Upper.budget k t n (Fintype.card (QuarticQuery.Upper.Tests t C)))
        fun x b => QuarticQuery.Upper.bern (val x) b)
      (And
        (∀
          (x :
            QuarticQuery.BitInput
              (QuarticQuery.BitLoc (HMul.hMul 2 t) (HMul.hMul 40 t) C.size (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t))),
          Eq (QuarticQuery.Fkm k t C x) false →
            LE.le (val x)
              (HMul.hMul (↑(QuarticQuery.Tournament.Tval (QuarticQuery.mValue t)))
                (QuarticQuery.Tournament.epsval (QuarticQuery.mValue t))))
        (∀
          (x :
            QuarticQuery.BitInput
              (QuarticQuery.BitLoc (HMul.hMul 2 t) (HMul.hMul 40 t) C.size (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t))),
          Eq (QuarticQuery.Fkm k t C x) true →
            LE.le (HSub.hSub 1 (val x))
              (HAdd.hAdd
                (HAdd.hAdd
                  (HDiv.hDiv (HMul.hMul 2 ↑(QuarticQuery.mValue t))
                    (HPow.hPow 2 (QuarticQuery.Tournament.Tval (QuarticQuery.mValue t))))
                  (HMul.hMul (↑(QuarticQuery.Tournament.Tval (QuarticQuery.mValue t)))
                    (QuarticQuery.Tournament.epsval (QuarticQuery.mValue t))))
                (QuarticQuery.Tournament.epsval (QuarticQuery.mValue t)))))

declarations.name: QuarticQuery.Paper.quantumError_numeric
declarations.source_statement:
theorem quantumError_numeric {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) :
    (Tval m : ℝ) * epsval m = 1 / 1000 ∧
    2 * (m : ℝ) / 2 ^ Tval m + (Tval m : ℝ) * epsval m + epsval m < 1 / 3

    (LT.lt

theorem equation_15 {ι Col Z : Type} [Fintype Col] [Nonempty Col] [Fintype Z]
    {c : ℕ} (o : Z)
    (F : Col → Col → BitInput ι → Reg Z ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] Reg Z)
    (hF : ∀ i j, IsCirc c (F i j)) (p : ℕ → Col) (t : ℕ) :
    ∃ (i₀ : Col)
      (A : BitInput ι → Reg (Σ _ : Col, TensorBasis Z t) ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ]
        Reg (Σ _ : Col, TensorBasis Z t)),
      IsCirc (t * c) A ∧
      ∀ x i, slice i (A x (rket (⟨i₀, tensorOrigin o t⟩ :
          Σ _ : Col, TensorBasis Z t))) =
        (((Real.sqrt ((Fintype.card Col : ℝ)⁻¹) : ℝ) : ℂ) •
          tensorVector (fun b => F i (p b) x (rket o)) t)

    lawOf v (tensorIndexOut out t) (some i) /
